text:
maria-ops: FYI @kai-finance — Nora Corp's invoice INV-7890 (due 03/20) hit multiple payment failures. Card declined 3x (last attempt 03/22 14:12 UTC), then customer tried to switch to ACH and microdeposits didn't verify (customer says amounts don't match). Need a plan: automated retries, manual charge attempt, or accept a one-time wire. Thoughts?

kai-finance: thanks — do we have the card on file tokenized? how many auto-retries has our system already queued?

maria-ops: tokenized yes. System did 3 auto-retries (policy = 3 attempts). Next auto-retry is disabled by default after 3. Customer is getting anxious and asked for a wire option.

ben-cs: I talked to their billing contact a few mins ago. They tried ACH via Plaid and got "account type mismatch" error. They're open to wire if we provide instructions quickly. They asked about waiving late fee if they wire within 48h.

kai-finance: waiving late fee is fine from finance for a one-time exception if legal signs off and we get proof of wire. @eve-legal can you confirm?

eve-legal: OK from legal in principle. We need: (1) signed PO or authorization email from a recognized billing contact, (2) copy of wire receipt once sent, (3) standard AML/KYC checks clear. No exceptions for bypassing KYC.

maria-ops: noted. I'll ask CS to get the PO and official billing contact email before we accept wire. Ben, can you paste their wire instructions here?

ben-cs: customer sent this (redacted):
```
Wire instructions
Bank: First Example Bank
Beneficiary: Nora Consulting LLC
Account: 000123456789 (they say last 4 = 6789)
Routing: 111000025
SWIFT: FEBEUS33
Reference: INV-7890
```

ben-cs: also flag — they requested we trigger one manual CC attempt after we receive authorization email (they might have fixed the card).

kai-finance: manual CC attempt is OK but we should only do 1 manual charge to avoid disputes. Manual attempt needs a timestamped email from billing contact authorizing charge and amount.

maria-ops: I'll pause any further automated retries and open a support ticket to coordinate. Will ask them to (a) email authorization for manual charge OR (b) send wire + receipt and PO.

stripe-bot: Payment retry attempts exhausted for customer:nora-corp (INV-7890). No further automatic retries scheduled.

ben-cs: customer on call now, sending PO and said they'll initiate wire within 2 business days if we waive late fee. I told them legal review may take a few hours.

kai-finance: please CC finance on the email authorization so we have audit trail. Also once we confirm wire, mark invoice PAID and record method = WIRE in ledger (leave original attempts in event log).

eve-legal: once we get PO/authorization, I can sign off within the hour. If KYC flags, we'll escalate.

maria-ops: action items: 1) Ben to get PO + billing contact email (Ben). 2) Maria to pause retries (done). 3) Kai to prepare manual-charge approval template (Kai). 4) Eve to be ready for quick legal sign-off. I'll update thread when PO arrives. :thumbsup:

ben-cs: sending PO now (cc finance). I'll also share the customer call notes in the ticket.

maria-ops: received PO via email, forwarding to @eve-legal and @kai-finance. Proceed with legal review + manual charge approval.

kai-finance: got it. Preparing approval template now. If legal clears, I will authorize a single manual charge attempt; otherwise we accept wire.

ben-cs: customer asked for the wire reference string to include INV-7890 so reconciliation is easier — confirmed they'll do that.

maria-ops: noted. I'll create the support ticket and set SLA 48h for resolution. Closing loop here after final payment confirmation. :bank:
